question: Which of the following is not included in the famous 'Panchjana' of Rigvedic times?
solution:
**The correct answer is - Bharat**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat**

 
 
• Bharat is not included in the famous 'Panchjana' of Rigvedic times.
 
• The Panchjana refers to five specific tribes mentioned in the Rigveda.
 
• The 'Bharatas' were a prominent tribe, but they are not part of the 'Panchjana'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Turvasha**

 
 
• One of the tribes included in the 'Panchjana' of Rigvedic times.
 
• Turvasha is mentioned in several hymns of the Rigveda.
 
 
 
• **Puru**
 
 
• Puru was another tribe included in the 'Panchjana'.
 
• The Purus were significant in Rigvedic history and frequently mentioned in the texts.
 
 
 
• **Druhya**
 
 
• The Druhyas are also counted among the 'Panchjana'.
 
• They are one of the lesser-known tribes but still part of the five tribes.
